verdict.rationale: Working Copy offers AI-generated commit message suggestions from staged diffs and a 'Repository Agent' conversational AI assistant that can browse, search, and act on repository content, which qualifies as AI-generated insights from the user's data. However, this is narrowly scoped to git workflows (commit messages, file browsing) rather than broader data insights, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of the Repository Agent's real-world performance. Missing for 10: independent verification of Repository Agent quality, broader insight types beyond commit messages, and any hands-on user reports of these AI features in action.
